cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Just nod and I'll accept the sofa delivery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. We can measure after securing the bargain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nod before they start measuring too.

heightening.evidence: B4 presence of the sofa makes the avoided measurement imminent, so A5 presses for a faster nod.

specificity.evidence: A1 sofa acceptance, B2 door and B4 outside location establish clear practical consequences and timing.
